headline.en: Inspect a model launch plan before running it.
headline.zh: 运行模型前先检查启动计划。

sub.en: ZeroRun compares GPU metadata with a versioned configuration registry, ranks feasible variants by a declared heuristic, and exposes the selected launch arguments.
sub.zh: ZeroRun 将 GPU 元数据与版本化配置登记表比较，按声明启发式排序可行变体，并展示选中的启动参数。

body.en: Rejected variants include their requirement shortfall.
body.zh: 被拒绝变体包含需求差额。

body.en: Model and backend choices live in YAML.
body.zh: 模型与后端选择保存在 YAML。

body.en: Dry-run exposes the plan without starting inference.
body.zh: dry-run 展示计划而不启动推理。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Use a simulated 24GB GPU with two explicit demo variants requiring 16GB and 32GB, then inspect the picker’s result.
note.zh: 对需要 16GB 与 32GB 的两个明确演示变体使用模拟 24GB GPU，检查 picker 结果。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Pure configuration selection for a synthetic model entry and a simulated 24GB GPU. No model files, real hardware feasibility, backend launch or performance are tested.

body.en: Use a simulated 24GB GPU with two explicit demo variants requiring 16GB and 32GB, then inspect the picker’s result.
body.zh: 对需要 16GB 与 32GB 的两个明确演示变体使用模拟 24GB GPU，检查 picker 结果。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/zerorun.git
cd zerorun
uv venv .venv
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e .
source .venv/bin/activate

limitations.en: Registry feasibility is based on declared floors, not a measured allocation or runtime acceptance test. Context, caches and backend versions can change requirements.
limitations.zh: 登记表可行性基于声明下限，不是实测分配或运行验收；上下文、缓存和后端版本会改变需求。

limitations.en: Ranking coefficients are heuristics, not measured accuracy or throughput. Verify model IDs, artifacts and chat templates before a real launch.
limitations.zh: 排序系数是启发式，不是实测精度或吞吐；真实启动前应核实模型 ID、产物和聊天模板。

limitations.en: The demo uses a synthetic model entry and simulated GPU. It downloads no weights and starts no backend.
limitations.zh: 示例使用合成模型条目和模拟 GPU，不下载权重或启动后端。

body.en: A model launch requires choosing a weight format, backend and matching arguments. Keeping those choices in a registry makes the decision inspectable and gives a dry-run path before a download or launch.
body.zh: 模型启动需要选择权重格式、后端和匹配参数。将选择保存在登记表中，便于检查决策，并可在下载或启动前 dry-run。

body.en: The probe obtains GPU data or uses an explicit simulation. Registry loaders validate entries; picker tests configured VRAM and compute-capability floors and ranks candidates. The launcher constructs backend arguments and can start a separate process.
body.zh: probe 获取 GPU 数据或使用显式模拟；登记表加载器校验条目，picker 检查配置显存和计算能力下限并排序，launcher 构造后端参数并可启动独立进程。

body.en: The probe obtains GPU data or uses an explicit simulation. Registry loaders validate entries; picker tests configured VRAM and compute-capability floors and ranks candidates. The launcher constructs backend arguments and can start a separate process.
body.zh: probe 获取 GPU 数据或使用显式模拟；登记表加载器校验条目，picker 检查配置显存和计算能力下限并排序，launcher 构造后端参数并可启动独立进程。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: ZERORUN_REGISTRY_DIR or the registry-dir option selects a custom registry. Entries define model, hf_id, quant/backend variants, min_vram_gb, compute_cap_min, args and chat_template_ref. --backend and --quant constrain selection; --dry-run prevents launch.
body.zh: ZERORUN_REGISTRY_DIR 或 registry-dir 选项指定自定义登记表。条目定义 model、hf_id、quant/backend、min_vram_gb、compute_cap_min、args 与 chat_template_ref。--backend 和 --quant 约束选择，--dry-run 阻止启动。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
zerorun --list --gpu "24:8.9"
zerorun <registered-alias> --dry-run --gpu "24:8.9"
# Use a validated registry entry and installed backend for real execution:
zerorun <registered-alias>
